categories.title: Categories
categories.subtitle: The catalog structure. Every product belongs to a category, and the category decides which attributes appear on the product form.
categories.parentHint: Changing the parent moves this category and all its children
categories.linkedAttributesHint: Attributes marked "creates variants" appear on the variant form; the rest appear on the product form.
categories.noAttributesLeft: Every attribute is already linked to this category.

attributes.title: Attributes
attributes.subtitle: Product properties — colour, size, weight. They get linked to categories once defined.
attributes.keyHint: lowercase letters and underscores — immutable after creation
attributes.optionsHint: Send the value exactly when setting an attribute value — not the label.
attributes.optionsOnlyForSelect: Options apply to SELECT and COLOR_SELECT attributes only.

brands.title: Brands
brands.subtitle: Optional on a product, but useful for filtering.

products.title: Products
products.subtitle: Every product has at least one variant — that is what carries the SKU, price and stock.
products.chooseCategoryHint: The category decides the product type and which attributes get filled in. It cannot be changed afterwards.
products.typeDerived: The type is derived from the category's attributes — it is not a manual choice.
products.typeVariableWhy: This category has variant-creating attributes, so the product must be variable.
products.typeSimpleWhy: This category has no variant-creating attributes, so the product is simple with one variant.
products.productAttributesHint: The category's informational attributes. The required ones must be filled in.
products.noProductAttributes: This category has no informational attributes.

variants.title: Variants
variants.subtitle: Each variant carries its own SKU, price and stock.
variants.attributesHint: Fill in every variant-creating attribute — no more, no fewer.
variants.simpleNotice: A simple product has one implicit variant; extra variants cannot be added.

prices.title: Prices
prices.noPrices: No prices set — a retail price is required before this can be sold.
prices.bulkHint: Fill in only what you want to change; blanks are left alone. All updates go in one transaction.

warehouses.title: Warehouses
warehouses.subtitle: The model supports several warehouses, but cart and orders always use the first active one — there is no warehouse picker in the UI yet.
warehouses.noDelete: Warehouses are never deleted, only deactivated — deleting one would orphan its stock movements.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.subtitle: Stock levels and movements per variant.
inventory.availableHint: on hand minus what open orders have reserved
inventory.noStock: No stock recorded for this variant yet.
inventory.receiveHint: Increases stock on hand. A reason is optional here.
inventory.adjustHint: A manual correction — negative values are allowed, and a reason is mandatory.

media.title: Images
media.hint: JPG, PNG, WEBP or GIF — up to 5 MB. Uploads go straight to storage, not through this server.

orders.title: Orders
orders.subtitle: The status flow drives stock: reserved on creation, actually deducted on confirmation.
orders.noTransitions: No transitions are available from this status.
orders.stockNote: Confirming deducts stock for real — there is no ordinary way back.
orders.paymentTimeout: Orders left awaiting payment for more than 15 minutes are cancelled automatically and their stock released.

payments.title: Payment
payments.mockNotice: The payment provider is currently a mock — there is no real gateway yet.
payments.refundHint: Partial refunds are supported — repeatedly, as long as the total stays within the original.

shipments.title: Shipments
shipments.createHint: The order must be ready to ship — creating a shipment moves it to shipped automatically.
shipments.deliverHint: Moves the order to delivered automatically.

imports.title: Product import
imports.subtitle: CSV upload in two stages: immediate error preview, then an explicit commit. Bad rows never block the good ones.
imports.columnsHint: The column map is fixed for now — names must match exactly.
imports.commitHint: Only valid rows create products; the rest are skipped.

reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: Sales figures, stock alerts and products nobody is buying.
reports.salesSubtitle: Counts orders that actually reached paid or beyond — not pending or cancelled ones.
reports.lowStockSubtitle: Every variant × warehouse at or below the threshold, least available first.
reports.noLowStock: Nothing below the threshold — stock is healthy.
reports.stagnantSubtitle: Published products with no orders in the period.

coupons.title: Coupons
coupons.subtitle: Discount codes by percentage or fixed amount, with use limits and validity dates.
coupons.valueHintFixed: a fixed amount in the system currency

customers.title: Customer price lists
customers.subtitle: Put a customer on a specific price list (wholesale) instead of the retail default. It applies to their cart and future orders.
customers.noLookup: The only endpoint that lists customers with their ids is `/users`, and that one needs users.manage. If you hold it, copy the id from the users page and paste it here.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Staff accounts and their roles. Customers show up here too — the API returns everyone in one list.
users.newHint: Created active straight away, unlike public sign-up.
users.roleDelay: Applies immediately, but an already-issued token keeps its old permissions for up to 15 minutes
users.statusHint: Anything but active is refused at login
users.selfNotice: You cannot change your own role or status here — demoting or disabling yourself would lock you out with nothing left but a database edit.
users.noDelete: Accounts are never deleted, only disabled: orders and stock movements reference whoever made them.

shop.title: Shop
shop.subtitle: Browse every product and filter by category, brand or price.
shop.pickCategoryFirst: Pick a category to reveal filters based on its attributes.
shop.noFilterableAttributes: This category has no filterable attributes.

shop.loginToBuyHint: The cart is tied to your account, so your pricing and orders stay with you.

cart.title: Cart
cart.noTotal: We cannot total this cart — an item has no price.

checkout.title: Checkout

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: What you need to know about ordering, delivery and your account.

items.q: Do I need an account to order?
items.a: Browsing and prices are open to everyone. Adding to the cart and checking out need an account, because the cart lives on the server against your login — that is what keeps your pricing and your orders with you across devices.

items.q: How do I track my order?
items.a: The "My orders" page shows each order status step by step — payment, confirmation, processing, shipping. Once it ships, the carrier and tracking number appear there too.
Yes. If your account is set to a wholesale price list, you see your own prices automatically once signed in — no code, no extra step.

items.q: Why do some products have a minimum order quantity?
items.a: Some stock is sold in fixed units (reams of paper, ink cartridges). The minimum is shown on the product page under the quantity field, and an order below it is rejected.
You can cancel it yourself while it has not shipped. Open the order and the cancel button appears when its status still allows it; after shipping, contact us instead.
All prices are in US dollars (USD), shown to two decimal places.

items.q: A product says "out of stock" — what does that mean?
items.a: That particular option has run out in the warehouse. The button is disabled so you do not reach checkout only to be refused. Try another option of the same product, or check back later.
